targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(r.finished_at, r.started_at))::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'))::bigint AS time,
  h.host_name AS metric,
  COUNT(tr.id) AS tests_executed
FROM test_runs r
JOIN test_results tr ON tr.run_id = r.run_id
JOIN hosts h ON h.id = tr.host_id
JOIN tests t ON t.id = tr.test_id
WHERE COALESCE(r.finished_at, r.started_at) BETWEEN
  (TO_TIMESTAMP(${__from}/1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')
  AND (TO_TIMESTAMP(${__to}/1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')
  AND ('${suite}' = '' OR t.test_suite = ${suite:sqlstring})
  AND ('${host:csv}' = '__all' OR h.host_name = ANY(string_to_array('${host:csv}', ',')))
GROUP BY r.run_id, h.host_name, r.finished_at, r.started_at
ORDER BY COALESCE(r.finished_at, r.started_at);

SELECT
  (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(r.finished_at, r.started_at))::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'))::bigint AS time,
  h.host_name AS metric,
  COUNT(tr.id) AS tests_failed
FROM test_runs r
JOIN test_results tr ON tr.run_id = r.run_id
JOIN hosts h ON h.id = tr.host_id
JOIN tests t ON t.id = tr.test_id
WHERE COALESCE(r.finished_at, r.started_at) BETWEEN
  (TO_TIMESTAMP(${__from}/1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')
  AND (TO_TIMESTAMP(${__to}/1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')
  AND ('${suite}' = '' OR t.test_suite = ${suite:sqlstring})
  AND ('${host:csv}' = '__all' OR h.host_name = ANY(string_to_array('${host:csv}', ',')))
  AND tr.status = 'fail'
GROUP BY r.run_id, h.host_name, r.finished_at, r.started_at
ORDER BY COALESCE(r.finished_at, r.started_at);

SELECT
  r.run_id,
  TO_CHAR(r.started_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS started_at,
  COUNT(tr.id) AS tests_executed,
  ROUND(AVG(tr.duration_ms), 2) AS avg_test_duration_ms
FROM test_runs r
JOIN test_results tr ON tr.run_id = r.run_id
JOIN hosts h ON h.id = tr.host_id
JOIN tests t ON t.id = tr.test_id
WHERE r.started_at BETWEEN
  (TO_TIMESTAMP(${__from}/1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')
  AND (TO_TIMESTAMP(${__to}/1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')
  AND ('${suite}' = '' OR t.test_suite = ${suite:sqlstring})
  AND ('${host:csv}' = '__all' OR h.host_name = ANY(string_to_array('${host:csv}', ',')))
GROUP BY r.run_id, r.started_at
ORDER BY r.started_at DESC;

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT t.test_suite AS __value, t.test_suite AS __text, (t.test_suite)::text AS __ord0 FROM tests t JOIN test_results tr ON tr.test_id = t.id JOIN test_runs r ON r.run_id = tr.run_id WHERE t.test_suite IS NOT NULL AND t.test_suite <> '' AND r.started_at BETWEEN (TO_TIMESTAMP(${__from}/1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AND (TO_TIMESTAMP(${__to}/1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') ORDER BY __ord0
